module: Auxiliary H-pattern gear lever animation controller (manual gearbox). Follows the engaged gear of the "gearbox" device and moves a virtual lever on two axes (electrics hPatternAxisX / hPatternAxisY) through the gate: on engagement, it moves first in X then in Y; on disengagement, first in Y then in X. Plays an engagement and disengagement sound with the shift aggression. Rapid gear changes are queued (dequeue) to be animated one after the other.
notes: jbeam keys read: gearCoordinates (header table with columns gearIndex, x, y), electricsNameXAxis ("hPatternAxisX"), electricsNameYAxis ("hPatternAxisY"), supportedGearboxTypes ({"manualGearbox"}), relevantGearboxName ("gearbox"), shiftSoundNode_nodes (first element = sound node, otherwise 0 + log W), shiftSoundEventHPatternGearIn ("event:>Vehicle>Interior>Gearshift>manual_modern_01_in"), shiftSoundEventHPatternGearOut ("..._01_out"), shiftSoundVolumeHPatternGearIn / GearOut (0.5), demoMode (false).
Reads controller.mainController.shiftingAggression (animation speed between 0.3 and 1 times the base speed) and electrics.values.isShifting.
If the device is not found or of an unsupported type, log E and updateGFX becomes nop; demoMode reactivates updateGFX and cycles through the gears automatically (demonstration).
In neutral, after the shift ends, X is recentered on the coordinate of gear 0.

init.desc: Reads the H-pattern gate coordinates, checks the gearbox device and initializes sounds and the gear queue.

reset.desc: Resets the lever to (0, 0), clears the gear queue and resets smoothers and demo.

updateGFX.desc: Every frame: queues the gear changes, moves the lever in X/Y, plays the sounds and publishes the electrics.
